text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeat in the Japanese Derby, the second 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown. Seiun Sky 
silently chewed on his frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Special Week, whose dreams had 
also been shattered, was deeply 
frustrated, yet immediately began burning 
with fighting spirit for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky feels threatened by her mental 
fortitude. The contest moves onward to the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown: the 
Kikuka Sho—
